headline: Deadlocked reaches 1.33% after stricter checks remove false matches
summary: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 matched code rose from 0.51% to 1.33%, with 808 of 15,056 functions reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The large contribution in #3 adds resident and level routines while tightening the verification tools.
highlights: Strict constant comparisons remove 55 false matches from the source tree.
The assembler helper stops treating a loop's alignment instruction as padding.
The batch also repairs 82 near misses.
